pages.text: This dragon is massive in size, not unlike that of the Red Death. It's so big that it has been known to cause seaquakes. This led Vikings to believe this was the Serpent of Midgard from legend, heralded to bring Ragnarok, i.e. the end of the world.$(l)$(br2)Spawns:$()$(br)Purple Death Nests$(br2)$(l)Size$()$(br)Length: 80 Blocks $(br)Wingspan: N/A Blocks
